title: Uncertainty-Aware AI: Conformal Prediction versus Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Trade Execution
description: Reference implementation and reproducibility package for a study of VWAP-benchmarked optimal trade execution. A normalised split-conformal predictor of next-interval returns is used as an explicit gate on execution decisions: the policy acts on the forecast only when its magnitude exceeds kappa times the conformal half-width, and otherwise tracks VWAP. Sweeping kappa traces a monotone cost-risk frontier, reducing the variance of execution cost at almost no cost in the mean, and more reproducibly than a multi-seed PPO agent. Software supplement to the article published in Statistics, Optimization & Information Computing 16(2), 1334-1349 (2026).
